# Laro

> Self-hostable recipe app for families — organize recipes, plan meals, shop, and cook together.

Laro is a kitchen OS for real weeknights: import recipes, build meal plans, generate shopping lists, and share a household cookbook. Available on the web and Android.

Key things to know:
- Free tier with optional Laro Pro (AI meal plans, imports, unlimited cookbook)
- Self-hostable; production site is https://laro.food/
- Privacy-first household sharing (invite / consent flows)

## Links
- [Home](https://laro.food/): App entry
- [Sign in](https://laro.food/#/auth): Login / register
